how_derived: On paper. p_hat = prior + floor(confidence x (signal - prior) / 1000000); net edge = p_hat - price - cost; the threshold is 20000 ppm and the condition is strictly greater. Price and prior are 400000, confidence 500000, default cost 10000.

S02-C1.why: signal 460000: p_hat 430000, net 430000 - 400000 - 10000 = 20000, equal to the threshold

S02-C3.why: signal 500000: p_hat 450000; cost 30000 + 25000 = 55000; net -5000: the cost is larger than the edge

S02-C5.why: signal 460001: 0.5 x 60001 = 30000.5, floored to 30000; p_hat 430000, net 20000: rounding never helps the trade
